description: ONE backend-agnostic compatibility corpus. `modes` records which legacy per-mode corpus carried each program, so the four legacy views stay byte-reproducible during migration; it is NOT a statement that other backends cannot run the program. A mode absent from `modes` with no entry in `exclusions` is an UNEXPLAINED gap, and the matrix driver reports it as NOT_ATTEMPTED(unexplained) rather than omitting the cell.

lsof.e9patch: not carried by the legacy e9patch corpus; reason not recorded upstream
lsof.rr: not carried by the legacy rr corpus; reason not recorded upstream
lsof.sabre: not carried by the legacy sabre corpus; reason not recorded upstream

make-parallel.e9patch: added by PR #2042, which measured L2 bitwise parity for this program on the ptrace/strict backend only and explicitly deferred the sabre/e9patch/rr decision to the backend-agnostic corpus work; not a statement that this backend cannot run it
make-parallel.rr: added by PR #2042, which measured L2 bitwise parity for this program on the ptrace/strict backend only and explicitly deferred the sabre/e9patch/rr decision to the backend-agnostic corpus work; not a statement that this backend cannot run it
